title: 1984 Apple's First Macintosh Commercial
summary: The famous 1984 Apple Macintosh television commercial, framed as a rebellion against an Orwellian Big Brother. This copy was uploaded to YouTube just after the site launched.
why: HN mostly uses it as a cultural reference, either as a favorite tech ad or as irony when criticizing Apple's later restrictiveness.

quote.text: The Apple 1984 commercial is my favorite
